exposure: Information preference towards mode of delivery
cohort: 368 antenatal mothers after 36 weeks of gestation without medical reasons against vaginal delivery
finding: The study found that 30.9% of participants preferred cesarean delivery, and this preference was independently associated with pre-existing anxiety or depression, pregnancy through IVF, and a history of previous cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: A history of previous cesarean delivery was found to be an independent predictor for preference for cesarean delivery.
